subtitle: Mercury, the HF radio modem of the HERMES project

apps.name: Mercury
apps.subtitle: Email and files over HF radio
apps.localizedDescription: Mercury is a software modem for sending email, files and messages over HF radio. Connect your phone or tablet to a single-sideband transceiver through an audio interface, and Mercury turns the radio into a data link with a VARA-compatible TNC, so Winlink clients such as Pat can use it. Free software (GPL-3.0) from the HERMES project of Rhizomatica. Transmitting needs an amateur-radio licence.

versions.localizedDescription: First notarized build: the Mercury GUI with the modem inside, on RemoteIO. Technology preview, as in the 1.9.20 release.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mercury needs access to the radio audio to listen for data signals
